auditMetadata.finalDecision: READY FOR DEPLOYMENT, SUBJECT TO NORMAL OPERATIONAL CONTROLS

findings.title: Insecure Unsigned Admin Session Cookie Permitted Trivial Session Forgery
findings.verificationMethod: Automated script tested forged base64 cookies, tampered payloads, expired tokens, and genuine signed sessions. All forgery attempts rejected with HTTP 401.
findings.remainingRisk: None in codebase. Requires ADMIN_JWT_SECRET environment variable in production.

findings.title: Client-Controlled Authorization Bypass in Core Administrative Endpoints
findings.verificationMethod: Automated script tested ?admin=true and x-recars-role: admin on customers, inquiries, test-drive, cars, sell approve, and sell delist. All returned HTTP 401.

findings.title: Completely Unauthenticated Mutation on Vehicles, Dealers, and Listings
findings.verificationMethod: Direct unauthenticated POST/PATCH/DELETE mutations against catalog and approval routes return HTTP 401.

findings.title: Unrestricted Public Scraping of Customer PII Across Core Records
findings.verificationMethod: Automated script tested GET queries across all 8 PII endpoints; all returned HTTP 401. Public customer enquiry submissions remain functional.

findings.title: Plaintext Production Database Password in Code Fallback and Example Configuration
findings.status: FIXED AND VERIFIED (CODEBASE) / REQUIRES MANUAL VERIFICATION (SUPABASE DASHBOARD)
findings.verificationMethod: Grep confirmed no hardcoded credentials remain in active code or .env.example. Database requires DATABASE_URL.
findings.remainingRisk: Database password must be rotated in the Supabase Cloud dashboard to invalidate previously committed history.

findings.title: Sensitive Dealer Margin & Cost Fields Exposed in Public Vehicle Inventory API
findings.verificationMethod: Public GET /api/cars inspected; dealerPrice, dealerMargin, purchaseCost, and dealerPhone confirmed stripped.

findings.title: Unrestricted File Upload & Processing Denial of Service
findings.verificationMethod: 16MB multipart payload returned HTTP 400. 21MB Base64 payload returned HTTP 400. Rate limiting active at 30 req/min.

findings.title: Missing Standard HTTP Security Headers
findings.verificationMethod: Verified X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, HSTS, and Permissions-Policy on live responses.

findings.title: Known Vulnerabilities in Outdated NPM Dependencies
findings.verificationMethod: All runtime server request handling packages patched. Remaining advisory in transitive @grpc/grpc-js confirmed non-exploitable client context.
